Staker in fast time, and D. Christie-Murray, the Surrey W.C. and Oxford University athlete, finished second, with A.
Bob Readman walked splendidly to finish second to Staker in the Middlesex. Had the race been over the pre-war distance of ten miles, Bob may have done even better.
He did just that on 7th July 1939 at White City;he won from Staker (Highgate) and our own Joe Coleman).
